int head[10000], to[100000], ct[100000], w[100000], nt[100000];
int d[10000], vis[10000];
int pre[10000], id[10000];
int s, t, tot;

void add_edge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
    to[tot] = v; ct[tot] = cost; w[tot] = flow; nt[tot] = head[u]; head[u] = tot++;
    to[tot] = u; ct[tot] = -cost; w[tot] = 0; nt[tot] = head[v]; head[v] = tot++;
}

void initialize() {
    memset(head, -1, sizeof(head));
    tot = 0;
}

bool spfa(int s, int t) {
    std::queue<int> q;
    memset(d, 0x3f, sizeof(d));
    memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
    memset(pre, -1, sizeof(pre));
    d[s] = 0;
    q.push(s);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        vis[u] = 0;
        for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = nt[i]) {
            if (w[i] > 0 && d[to[i]] > d[u] + ct[i]) {

                }
